narr: A cold front moved in from the northwest causing thunderstorms to develop resulting in some flash flooding in portions of Arkansas and southwestern Tennessee.
ev: Flash flooding occurred from eastern Jonesboro through the downtown area. Multiple roads flooded and several cars were stranded.
lsr: NUMEROUS ROAD FLOODING FROM HEAVY RAIN. SEVERAL CARS FLOODED. ROADS FLOODING FROM DOWNTOWN TO EASTERN PARTS OF JONESBORO.
